pc.notes: Tree Chopper v3 is built in -- the polished one. The pack now has its own icon in-game, a settings item that opens an in-game menu (toggles for axe durability, leaf clearing, and leaf drops, saved to your world), and a one-time hello message the first time you join a world with it on. The chopping itself is the same v2 behavior: your axe wears for real and can break mid-tree, and leaves clear with their drop chances.

phone.notes: Tree Chopper got polished. The built-in add-on is now v3: it has a real pack icon in-game (no more generic placeholder), a settings item that opens an in-game settings menu -- toggles for axe durability, leaf clearing, and leaf drops, saved to the world -- and a short one-time intro message the first time you join a world with it on. Chopping works exactly like v2: your axe wears for real and can break mid-tree, leaves vanish with their sapling, stick, and apple chances. The add-on updates in place, so your worlds just pick up v3. The app itself is unchanged from 1.4 apart from the new add-on inside.
